notes: Sources cover all 7 subareas identified: coding assistants, business agents, tool landscape/adoption, open-source/open-weights, frontier tooling, dev infrastructure, and AI-in-SE practice. All domains verified to resolve and serve feeds (or have crawl_root endpoints noted for bot-protected/vendor sites). Policy-like sources map to vendor/think-tank commentary for this fast-moving space. Excluded as subscribed: ghuntley.com and zoltanbourne.substack.com. OpenAlex API and GitHub API are used as crawl endpoints for academic and OSS discovery respectively. For bot-protected vendor domains (openai.com, anthropic docs, ai.google.dev), the engine should rely on feed-verified secondary sources.
